```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Families and individuals should have the option of keeping the coverage they have or choosing from a wide array of health insurance plans, including many private health insurance options and a public plan.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Coverage should be made affordable for all Americans with subsidies provided through tax credits and other means.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Health care should be a shared responsibility between employers, workers, insurers, providers and government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"All Americans should have coverage they can afford.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Employers should have incentives to provide coverage to their workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Insurers and providers should ensure high quality affordable care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The government should ensure that health insurance is affordable and provides meaningful coverage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As affordable coverage is made available, individuals should purchase health insurance and take steps to lead healthy lives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Health insurance plans should accept all applicants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Health insurance plans should be prohibited from charging different prices based on pre-existing conditions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Health insurance plans should compete on the cost of providing health care and the quality of that care, not on their ability to avoid or over-charge people who are or may get sick.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Premiums collected by insurers should be primarily dedicated to care, not profits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
